title: mymind welcome
description: A soft, wide pool of tangerine-to-peach light with a two-line italic serif greeting in white (the second line stepped right), an optional small brand mark tucked beside it, and a small tangerine pill in spaced capitals; on wider screens a row of install tiles follows below the light.
notes: the white greeting needs the glow behind it: the glow comes from primary and chart-1, so it re-themes, but pale primaries make the text hard to read
the install row is hidden on phones, as in the original
